## Responsible Disclosure Notice

If this is a sensitive security vulnerability, please do NOT file a public issue.
Instead, report it privately by emailing the repository maintainer or using the
repository's private vulnerability reporting feature if available.

Public issues should only be used for non-sensitive security improvements such as
hardening suggestions, dependency updates, or configuration improvements.
